company.name: The Running Centre
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Sports nutrition fuel: energy bars, gels, hydration and recovery products from brands such as PURE, Pillar, BIX, Tailwind, Koda, Maurten and Hammer
company.channels_supplied: Its running store on Hay Street, West Perth, and its own online shop
what_they_do_well: Listed by On as an authorised dealer for its running shoes and apparel in West Perth.
company.fit_rationale: A West Perth running shop whose own website has a fuel section with a Bars category alongside gels and hydration, all from other brands. Health-conscious runners are a good audience for Diablo's muesli and cereal bars. Tier 3 because it is a single store with a small food shelf.
